title: Spanish Verb Comprar Practice: Regular Forms, Shopping and Quiz
description: Practice the Spanish verb comprar: a regular -ar verb in the present and preterite, comprar for someone, shopping phrases, ten questions and a reading.
intro: Comprar is a regular -ar verb, which makes it a model for many others. Learn the present and the preterite, how to say buy for someone and useful shopping phrases, then practice with instant feedback.

demand.source: Google autocomplete for US searchers (hl=en, gl=us), docs/seo-plan/us1000/suggest-us-20261127b.csv

uses.example: Le compré un regalo a mi mamá.
uses.meaning: I bought my mom a present.

uses.use: Ir de compras: to go shopping

uses.example: Mi papá hace el mandado los viernes.
uses.meaning: My dad does the grocery shopping on Fridays.

paragraphs: Cada viernes, Diego y su mamá van al supermercado latino de su barrio en Houston. Su mamá escribe la lista: tortillas, frijoles, aguacates y pan dulce. Diego siempre compra algo que no está en la lista, normalmente chicles o una revista.

Este viernes, su mamá le dio veinte dólares y le dijo: «Hoy tú compras todo». Diego comparó precios, buscó ofertas y compró todo lo de la lista con dieciocho dólares. Con los dos dólares que sobraron, le compró a su mamá una rosa.

comprehension.before: Diego y su mamá van al supermercado

comprehension.why: His mom gave him twenty dollars.

comprehension.before: Con el dinero que sobró, Diego compró

mistakes.why: Without the accent, compre is a different form (subjunctive).

mistakes.right: Le compré un regalo a mi mamá.
mistakes.why: The person you buy for is an indirect object: le… a mi mamá.
Preterite él needs the accent: compró.
To go shopping is ir de compras.

heritage: In the US, many heritage speakers say «hacer el mandado» or «ir a la tienda» for grocery shopping. Also common is «comprar para atrás», a calque of «buy back»; the standard forms are «recomprar» or «volver a comprar».
teacher: Set up a class market with price tags: students buy and sell with ¿Cuánto cuesta? and Compro…, then report with the preterite what everyone bought.
